<document id=DOC_req_open_enum>
Required: PostgreSQL, Redis or similar databases.
</document>

State whether the candidate meets the requirement below, and say whether
you matched a named item or judged something equivalent.

response.text: Yes — it meets the requirement by equivalence, not by a named match. The requirement names PostgreSQL or Redis (or similar databases); the candidate names MySQL, which is a comparable relational database to PostgreSQL.
